name: The Sanya EDITION
insider_take: Where ultra-modern luxury meets tropical paradise on China's "Hawaii" – Hainan Island's crown jewel resort destination.
whats_special: The Sanya EDITION sits on pristine Haitang Bay, home to China's only year-round tropical climate. This Ian Schrager-designed property features the brand's signature nightlife scene with a rooftop bar overlooking the South China Sea. The hotel's location in Sanya's luxury resort corridor puts you minutes from duty-free shopping at the world's largest Hermès store outside of Paris.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the spa during sunset hours – the floor-to-ceiling windows offer stunning views of the bay while you relax, and the golden hour lighting is Instagram-perfect.
dont_miss: The hotel's Beach Club transforms from a sophisticated day lounge to Sanya's hottest nightspot after dark. Take advantage of the complimentary snorkeling gear to explore the coral reefs right off the beach, or venture to nearby Wuzhizhou Island – China's premier diving destination just a 20-minute boat ride away.
pros: Contemporary luxury design with sophisticated Ian Schrager aesthetics
Prime beachfront location on Haitang Bay with pristine beach access
World-class spa and wellness facilities with innovative treatments
Exceptional dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
cons: Remote location requires transportation to reach Sanya city center
